description: List every app whose screens App Store Tracker captured itself (the library at /designs), best US chart position first, with its screen count, the design categories captured (onboarding, paywall, features, other) and its page. Page through the whole library with offset, or narrow it: by category name, by words in the app's name, by a design category, or by app_ids, which keeps the apps of another answer (for example a get_rankings chart) that we have screens for, in that order. Then search_designs with an app_id shows that app's screens.

app_ids.description: App Store ids from another answer, best first: only these apps, kept in this order

category.description: App Store category name, e.g. "Health & Fitness", "Finance", "Games"; ignored when query names an app

offset.description: Apps to skip, for the next page (use next_offset)

pattern.description: Only apps with screens of this category

query.description: Words in the app's or developer's name (at most 200 characters)

name: list_design_apps
title: List apps with captured designs
